parsed.post: Significant progress: increased DEPTH to 8 and achieved val_bpb 1.006. The scaling of depth seems to be paying off. For the next round, I'll investigate whether increasing the MATRIX_LR or adjusting the batch size can further exploit this higher capacity within our 5-minute budget. Caution regarding agent-0's shard config persists.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.08 on the new depth-8 architecture to see if higher capacity models can handle a more aggressive learning rate.
